messages.subject: Econometrics-Spatial , Quantative Finance
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
 I was working on some simulation project in Econometrics , nestling largely upon The Spatial autoregressive Models
 1.The first-order spatial AR model
 2.The spatial autoregressive error model ,
 3.The general spatial model
 as well as Bayesian Spatial autoregressive models
 1.The Bayesian FAR model
 2.The Bayesian regression model
 etc

 Besides, I shall also be deploying Locally linear spatial models(Spatial expansion,DARP models etc ), Bayesian Locally linear spatial models and the other various nitty gritty of the econometrics annealed with quantative aspects of finance .

    I could find the implementations of some of the needed models/functions in MATLAB , but I am now required to work in R , so much so that I myself might have to code for implementing these if needs be . I would be obliged if you could let me know the provisions of above mentioned models in R , if any .
 Else, I would be keen to work with R and contribute to the Open Source Community .

Thanking You
Sumit Khanna

messages.subject: Re: Econometrics-Spatial , Quantative Finance
messages.body_plain:
Hi Sumit,

I think what you are looking for is related to my last year's gsoc project. I was working on the R package Spdep2, for some Bayesian methods of spatial econometrics. You can find the current stage of the package at r forge, https://r-forge.r-project.org/projects/spdep2/. It now has most of the functions of Spatial Econometrics Toolbox (in Matlab), but the package is still in development.

Thanking you,
Abhirup Mallik

Graduate Student,
School of Statistics,
University of Minnesota
